behaviors_covered.measurement.dmm_accuracy_bound: Complete non-default signed bounds and source example; zero reading, zero coefficients, signed full scale, additive errors, overrange/scalar/nonfinite rejection and recovery.
behaviors_covered.measurement.delta_resistance: Complete forward resistor/thermal-EMF experiment, offset shifts, reversed/zero drift, pure EMF and zero resistance, documented quadratic-drift bias, source examples, negative implied resistance/scalar/nonfinite rejection and recovery; decimal-linear boundary regression.
behaviors_covered.measurement.compensated_probe_loading: Complete unmatched complex-impedance oracle for absent/under/matched/over compensation; matched finite-source reduction, DC, zero Rs, zero amplitude, source example, every scalar/nonfinite rejection and recovery.
behaviors_covered.measurement.rectangular_aperture_respons: Complete exact-integral half-cycle/null/negative-lobe and source vectors; DC, zero time, both zero, tiny time, zero amplitude, negative/nonfinite rejection and recovery; extreme frequency zero-time regression.
behaviors_covered.measurement.sampling_jitter_snr: Complete non-default RMS-slope and source oracles, independent frequency/jitter/amplitude scaling, inclusive phase limit and just-outside rejection, tiny positive jitter, every scalar/nonfinite rejection and recovery; finite-output overflow and dimensional-underflow regressions.
behaviors_covered.measurement.correlated_voltage_ratio: Complete sensitivity-covariance and source examples, rho=-1,0,+1, exact cancellation and one-ULP near-perfect correlation, zero one/both uncertainties, coverage scaling, channel 1% boundaries, covariance/scalar/nonfinite rejection and recovery.

Native interactions, screenshots, narrow-window layout and full original-128 preservation are Main/reviewer gates, not tester observations.
No hardware calibration, parasitic probe response, nonlinear thermal drift cancellation or distributional coverage validation is claimed. Complete binary64 space is not exhaustively covered.
